title: EmeraldShop
description: A lightweight, flexible, and feature-rich currency trading shop plugin. Players can use the currency from Vault (excluding version 1.0.0) to purchase items. It supports daily purchase limits, automatic restocking, and fully customizable items.
body:
📖 What Does It Do?
EmeraldShop is a lightweight shop plugin designed for survival servers. It allows players to purchase items through an intuitive graphical interface using the server's virtual currency (via the Vault economy system). Server administrators can fully customize the items for sale, their prices, and daily purchase limits. The plugin also features an automatic restocking mechanism that resets players' purchase limits at a fixed time every day.

💡 Why Should You Download It?
Economy-Compatible, Plug-and-Play: Built on the Vault economy API, it seamlessly integrates with any major economy plugin (such as EssentialsX, CMI, EzEconomy, etc.) without requiring additional configuration.

Feature-Rich, Ready to Use Out of the Box: Includes practical features like daily purchase limits, automatic restocking, and admin hot reload commands, meeting the core needs of survival servers.

Highly Customizable: Freely add or modify items through simple YAML configuration files. Supports color codes, custom descriptions, and even one-click purchase of predefined item sets (such as the Netherite set).

📝 Key Information Before Downloading
Dependency Requirements: Vault and an economy plugin (such as EssentialsX) must be installed; otherwise, the plugin will not function.

Server Core: Requires Spigot 1.21+ or Paper 1.21+. Not compatible with CraftBukkit.

Current Version Limitations: The normal_netherite_set and prot4_netherite_set are hardcoded sets. For more custom sets, please look forward to future updates or contact the author.

Simplify economic circulation and make shop management easier.
Download EmeraldShop now and bring your server to life!
